recommended_plots.title: Footprint ATM installed base: 2022 actual vs 2028 forecast (per country)
recommended_plots.chart_type: grouped/paired horizontal bar (2022 vs 2028F) with % CAGR label
recommended_plots.why: The single most C-level-relevant view: which of our markets are growing their ATM base vs shrinking, and by how much, in one screen. Shows Austria (+0.1%), Albania (+5%), Serbia/Czech/Hungary (growing) as expansion territories vs Bulgaria/Bosnia/Slovenia/Ukraine (contracting) for capital allocation and service-contract planning.
recommended_plots.coverage: 15 of 17 countries with both an actual 2022 base and a 2028 forecast (RO,BG,HU,CZ,SK,HR,RS,UA,GR,AT,SI,AL,MK,BA,CY). Only Montenegro (ME) and Kosovo (XK) are missing - they sit inside 'CEE Others' with no per-country series. 2 data points per country (2022, 2028).

recommended_plots.title: Off-site vs branch-based ATM mix by country, 2022
recommended_plots.chart_type: 100% stacked horizontal bar (Off-site vs Branch-based; or 5-segment Hall/Lobby/TTW/Off-site for primary markets)
recommended_plots.scope: per-country comparison (with CEE 64% and WE 40% regional reference lines)
recommended_plots.why: Deployment strategy and addressable-services signal: high off-site shares (Croatia 77%, Greece 66%) mean IAD/retail-site servicing demand; high branch/TTW shares (Serbia 50% TTW, Austria 53% lobby) mean branch-self-service and recycler opportunities. Directly informs where managed-services and CIT propositions land.
recommended_plots.coverage: All 15 countries that have any location data: full 5-category Hall/Lobby/TTW/Off-site for the 10 primary markets (RO,BG,HU,CZ,SK,HR,RS,UA,GR,AT); only a 2-way Branch vs Off-site split for the 5 secondary markets (SI*,AL,MK*,BA,CY) - and SI & MK chapters may not carry even the 2-way split. ME & XK absent. Single year (2022).

recommended_plots.title: ATM installed base trend & YoY growth, 2018-2028 (regional overview, CEE vs Western Europe vs World)
recommended_plots.chart_type: dual-axis combo: lines = installed base (indexed or absolute), bars = YoY % growth; history 2018-2022 + forecast 2023-2028
recommended_plots.why: Sets the strategic backdrop in one chart: the whole industry is past peak and contracting (~-2 to -3.6% p.a. through 2022), with CEE forecast nearly flat (-0.1% CAGR to 2028) but Western Europe still falling -1.7% CAGR. Frames every market-level story for the board.
recommended_plots.coverage: Regional aggregates (CEE & WE) fully covered 2018-2028 (11 years, with a 2023-2028 forecast); World only 2021-2022 (2 points, no forecast in these reports). Footprint countries roll up into the regional lines but cannot be individually broken out on this view.

recommended_plots.title: Off-site ATM share over time, footprint primary markets, 2018-2022
recommended_plots.chart_type: multi-country line (off-site % of installed base by year)
recommended_plots.why: Shows the structural shift away from the branch that drives our addressable site count: off-site is the only location category growing region-wide while branch/TTW/hall shrink. Rising off-site share (Greece 58%->66%, Czech 61%->68%, Cyprus 42%->54%) signals where retail-site and IAD servicing demand is expanding fastest.
recommended_plots.coverage: 10 primary footprint markets with a full 2018-2022 location time series (RO,BG,HU,CZ,SK,HR,RS,UA,GR,AT) plus AL, BA, CY via their 2-way branch/off-site series = up to 13 countries, 5 years each. SI, MK, ME, XK lack a usable off-site time series.

catalogs.coverage_summary: This topic is the best-covered in both reports. For the 10 'primary' footprint markets (RO, BG, HU, CZ, SK, HR, RS, UA in the CEE volume; GR, AT in the WE volume) you get a complete, plot-ready stack: total installed base + YoY growth 2018-2022, a 5-category location split (Hall/Lobby/TTW/Off-site/Drive-through) for 2018-2022 and a 2022 cross-country snapshot, a long-run 1995-2028 chart, and an explicit per-country forecast installed base to 2028 with CAGR and density. The 5 'secondary' footprint markets (SI, AL, MK, BA in CEE; CY in WE) each have their own chapter with installed base + growth 2018-2022 and a 2028 forecast, but only a coarser 2-way Branch-based vs Off-site location split (Albania, Bosnia and Cyprus confirmed; Slovenia and North Macedonia may carry only the headline series). Regional CEE and WE totals are fully covered 2018-2028; a World total exists only for 2021-2022. The clear gaps: Montenegro (ME) and Kosovo (XK) have no dedicated chapter in either report and are absorbed into 'CEE Others' with no extractable per-country series, so any 17-country view will top out at 15. A minor consistency caveat: Romania's 2028 forecast prints as 10,150 in the regional table but 10,200 in its country table, and Cyprus shows two different totals (763 in key-metrics vs 963 installed base) due to scope - cite the country-chapter figure.

recommended_plots.title: Cash recycling adoption: % of ATM base that recycles notes, by country (end-2022)
recommended_plots.chart_type: horizontal bar (ranked), single year
metrics: recyclers as % of national ATM installed base
recommended_plots.why: This is the single most Printec-relevant slide: it shows where the recycler conversion wave has and has not happened, i.e. the open white-space for selling recycling-capable hardware/CIT-savings projects. Austria 26% and Czechia ~25% are mature; Bulgaria ~1%, Serbia ~0.4%, Greece 3% are wide-open. One bar per country, instantly readable.
recommended_plots.coverage: 10 of 17 countries (AT, CZ, SK, HU, RO, BG, HR, RS, UA, GR); 1 year (2022). Missing: CY, SI, BA, MK, AL, ME, XK have no Section 4.4 deposit figure (summary chapters).

recommended_plots.title: Automated note-deposit penetration vs recycler penetration, by country (end-2022)
recommended_plots.chart_type: grouped/paired horizontal bar (two series per country)
metrics: automated note deposit ATMs as % of base
recommended_plots.why: Shows the gap between 'accepts deposits' and 'actually recycles' — the upgrade headroom. Greece is the standout (44% accept deposits but only 3% recycle = huge recycler retrofit opportunity); Austria/Czechia have closed the gap (nearly all deposit ATMs recycle). C-level sees at a glance which markets are 'deposit but not recycling yet'.
recommended_plots.coverage: 10 of 17 countries (same set as above); 1 year (2022). 7 countries have no data.

recommended_plots.title: Installed base of recyclers and automated-deposit ATMs, absolute counts by country (end-2022)
recommended_plots.chart_type: stacked horizontal bar (recyclers + non-recycling deposit ATMs) per country
metrics: automated note-deposit ATM count (of which recyclers)
recommended_plots.why: Penetration % hides market size. Absolute counts size the actual hardware opportunity: Greece 3,189 deposit ATMs / only 206 recyclers, Ukraine 2,596/1,620, Czechia 1,958/1,423, Austria 2,287/2,278. Lets a C-level prioritise the biggest absolute retrofit pools, not just the highest-percentage gaps.
recommended_plots.coverage: 10 of 17 countries; 1 year (2022). 7 countries missing.

recommended_plots.title: Stand-alone deposit terminals (SATs) installed base by country (end-2022) — a declining legacy channel
recommended_plots.chart_type: bar (single year), countries with non-trivial SAT counts
recommended_plots.why: SATs are the legacy single-function deposit boxes RBR says are being removed region-wide. The Printec story: where SATs are still large (Ukraine 12,688, Greece 2,019, Romania 1,680, Croatia 63, Serbia 88, Austria 275) there is a migration opportunity from SATs to multifunction recycling ATMs. Frames a replacement-cycle pitch.
recommended_plots.coverage: 8 of 17 countries have SAT counts (UA, GR, RO, AT, RS, HR, CZ 22, SK 14; HU & BG = 0); 1 year (2022). No forecast and 7 footprint countries have no data.

catalogs.coverage_summary: Deposit & recycling is the best-covered structural topic for the footprint, but ONLY as a single end-2022 snapshot — there is NO time series and NO 2028 forecast for any deposit/recycling metric (RBR forecasts cover total installed base and shipments, not functionality mix; recycler growth appears only as qualitative narrative). 10 of the 17 footprint countries have a full per-country Figure 4.4/4.5 giving automated note-deposit ATM count, recycler count, and SAT count, each with a % of base: AT, CZ, SK, HU, RO, BG, HR, RS, UA and GR. The other 7 — Cyprus, Slovenia, Bosnia, North Macedonia, Albania, Montenegro and Kosovo — get only abbreviated summary chapters (Sections 1-5, no functionality figure), so they have zero deposit/recycling data. The story is strong and Printec-relevant: recycler penetration ranges from near-saturation (Austria 26% of base, essentially all deposit ATMs recycle; Czechia 73% of deposit ATMs recycle) down to near-greenfield (Bulgaria ~1%, Serbia ~0.4%, Greece 3% despite 44% deposit penetration), clearly mapping where recycler retrofit and SAT-to-recycler migration opportunities sit.

catalogs.coverage_summary: Coverage is strong for the core footprint: 9 footprint countries (GR, AT in the WE volume; RO, BG, HU, CZ, SK, HR, RS, UA in the CEE volume) have full per-country cash-withdrawal series — annual number and value, withdrawals per ATM per month, average withdrawal value, withdrawal value as % of GDP, and (for most) cash as a share of ATM transactions — covering 2018-2022 with 2023-2028 forecasts (number and value) at both regional and country level. Greece and Bulgaria/Czechia/Croatia even have full 1995-2028 annex time series. Two secondary CEE markets, Albania and North Macedonia, add lighter 2018-2022 history (number, value, avg value, % of GDP) but no forecast and no cash-transaction-share. The clear gaps are six footprint countries with little or no cash-usage data: Cyprus (WE secondary — only ATM count/density/forecast), Montenegro and Kosovo (not covered as standalone chapters), Bosnia & Herzegovina (count/density only), and Slovenia (chapter exists but the withdrawal volume/value table was not captured in the deep-read window). All cross-country comparisons should note that RBR transaction figures are "primary markets only," and most value series carry both local-currency and USD figures (USD trends are distorted by 2022 currency depreciation, so local-currency or %-of-GDP framings are safer for C-level comparison).

catalogs.coverage_summary: Density & cross-country benchmarking is the single best-covered topic in these reports for the footprint: a consistent five-measure 'Density measures, 2022' table (ATMs per million people, per 100 bank branches, per 100 branches+post offices, per 1,000 km², per USD bn GDP) exists for 15 of the 17 markets — all 8 CEE primary (BG, HR, CZ, HU, RO, RS, SK, UA), all 4 CEE secondary (AL, BA, MK, SI) and the 3 WE markets (GR, AT, CY) — each given as country value + rank + regional average, and the CEE/WE regional master tables (p.26 / p.28) put every primary market side-by-side. Population, bank-branch and GDP context underpinning the ratios is available throughout, and the global benchmark (World 380 per million, 305 per 100 branches) is carried in the regional Key-metrics tables. The two main gaps: (1) Montenegro and Kosovo appear only in the compact CEE tertiary-markets table (p.600) with just three of the five density measures — no per-100-branches figures; and (2) density is a 2022 snapshot only — there is no per-country density forecast to 2028 (only ATM-count forecasts), so all benchmark plots are single-year except a tertiary-group per-million projection that is not country-specific. Net: a C-level can get full 17-country saturation/white-space benchmarking for 2022, with 15/17 on the full metric set and 17/17 on the two headline ratios (per-million and per-USD-bn-GDP).

catalogs.coverage_summary: Coverage of the 'Forecasts to 2028' topic is exceptionally strong. Both RBR reports devote a full Section 3 (regional) plus per-country Section 6/7 (primary) and Section 5 (secondary) to forward projections, all running 2023-2028 with CAGR and a marked forecast tail back to 1995. Every forward metric — installed base, shipments (with new-install vs replacement split), cash-withdrawal number, and cash-withdrawal value — exists at regional aggregate AND per-country level. Of the 17 footprint countries, 15 have a country-level installed-base + shipments forecast (10 primary: BG,HR,CZ,HU,RO,RS,SK,UA,AT,GR, with full withdrawal number/value forecasts; 5 secondary: SI,MK,BA,AL,CY — installed-base forecasts, with shipment splits for all except CY, and no withdrawal-value forecasts). The two genuine gaps are Montenegro (ME) and Kosovo (XK), which appear only inside the CEE 'Others' bucket with no standalone forecast series. The one topical gap across all countries is recycling/deposit: it is covered only as 2022 baseline counts plus qualitative 'expected to grow' narrative — there is NO numeric per-year recycler/deposit forecast table, so any recycling-growth plot must use 2022 actuals plus directional commentary, not a forecast series.
